# Smashed Burgers & Co.

> Smash burger restaurant in Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala, India. Beef patties are smashed to order on a flat-top griddle. Fries are cooked in beef tallow. Open every day from 6 PM to 4 AM. Delivery through Zomato.

## Facts

- Name: Smashed Burgers & Co. (also written Smashed Burgers Co.)
- Address: 64/5257 G, Kathrikadavu, Kaloor Kadavanthra Road, Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala, India
- Hours: every day, 6 PM to 4 AM
- Delivery: Zomato, listed as "Smashed Burgers & Co, Kaloor"
- Average cost: about ₹500 for two people, per Zomato
- Instagram: @smashedburgersandco
- Tagline: "Obsession doesn't take days off"

## Menu

Prices in Indian rupees from the restaurant's menu. Delivery prices on Zomato can differ.
House favourites are marked ★.

### Starters
- Tallow Fries ★ (₹200): fat-cut fries cooked in beef tallow, salt and crushed pepper.

### House special burgers
- OG Smash (single ₹179, double ₹249, cheeseburger ₹299): smashed beef patty, melted cheddar, house sauce, pickles, toasted brioche bun.
- The Alchemy ★ (₹329): two smashed patties, signature sauce, melted cheese, caramelised onions.
- Max Gains (₹349): two smashed patties, sunny-side-up egg, yoghurt sauce. The high-protein option.
- Jammin' Bacon ★ (₹349): two smashed patties, smoky beef bacon jam, cheese, pickles, lettuce, house sauces.
- Tokyo ★ (₹399): two smashed patties, melted cheese, mushrooms sautéed in house Tokyo sauce.
- Ranch Reserve ★ (₹450): two smashed patties, beef bacon bits, onion rings, signature ranch sauce.
- Animal Smash (on Zomato): two smashed patties, signature animal sauce, double melted cheese, crisp lettuce. A take on the California double animal style.

### Chicken
- Nashville Hot Chicken Sando (₹249): fried chicken thigh, Nashville hot spice, pickles, house sauce, toasted bun.

### Add-ons (any burger)
- Smashed patty ₹80, sunny-side egg ₹25, cheese slice ₹15, jalapeños ₹15.

### Mocktails
- Green Apple ₹120, Citrus Surge ₹120, Lychee Sunset ₹150, Orange and Mint ₹150.
